# NEW 2026-11-20 v6.9 yuan-restore23, the Yuan's restoration route, phases 1-3 (oe_yr_). Generated by gen_yuan_restore.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Any scope, monthly: called by the main-line scheduler (gen_mainline_lock.py, LINES id 39 "yr").
oe_yr_monthly = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_init } } oe_yr_setup = yes }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_m value = oe_yr_m_now }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_note } oe_yr_note_step = yes }
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_on }
        oe_yr_end_check = yes
        if = {
            limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_on }
            oe_yr_resync = yes
            if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_opened } } oe_yr_watch_open = yes }
            else = { oe_yr_step = yes }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_on }
            if = { limit = { current_month = 1 } oe_yr_stage_mods_apply = yes }
            oe_yr_ev_pick = yes
        }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_dbg_n_y1 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_y1n value = global_var:oe_dbg_n_y1 } }
}
# Any scope. The first run in a game.
oe_yr_setup = {
    set_global_variable = oe_yr_init
    if = {
        limit = { current_date < 1373.1.1 oe_yr_yuan_ok = yes }
        set_global_variable = oe_yr_on
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_path value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_stage value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_hold value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_strain value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_saved value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_cut value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_int_d value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_p3run value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_shirun value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_how value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_ever1 value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_defer value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_fields value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_keju value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_court_m value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_p6_defer value = 0 }
        debug_log = "oe_yr: the line runs (the restoration opens from 1355.1.1 by one of four ways)"
    }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_end value = 8 } debug_log = "oe_yr: too late, no suppression line or no Mongol Yuan: the line stays off (code 8)" }
}
# Any scope (F6's COLLAPSE_HOOKS; also this line's monthly check). The Yuan has fallen: strip ALL modifiers (including lasting ones).
oe_yr_on_yuan_fall = {
    oe_yr_strip_all = yes
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_on } oe_yr_finish = { code = 3 } }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_note } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_note }
}
# Any scope, monthly. The end: the collapse (3), 1400.1.1 (5: stage modifiers come off; lasting ones stay).
oe_yr_end_check = {
    if = { limit = { oe_yr_yuan_ok = no } oe_yr_on_yuan_fall = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { current_date >= 1400.1.1 } oe_yr_finish = { code = 5 } }
}
# Any scope. Usage: oe_yr_finish = { code = N }: stage modifiers off, the line closed (oe_yr_end = N), nothing due.
oe_yr_finish = {
    oe_yr_strip = yes
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_d1 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_d1 } if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_d2 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_d2 } if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_d3 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_d3 } if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_d4 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_d4 } if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_d5 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_d5 } if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_d6 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_d6 } if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_d7 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_d7 } if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_d8 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_d8 } if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_d9 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_d9 } if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_d10 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_d10 } if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_d11 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_d11 } if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_ask1 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_ask1 } if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_ask5 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_ask5 } if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_ask6 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_ask6 } if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_ask7 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_ask7 } if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_ask10 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_ask10 } if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_ask11 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_ask11 }
    remove_global_variable = oe_yr_on
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_end value = $code$ }
    debug_log = "oe_yr: the line ends (code in oe_yr_end)"
}
# Any scope. Stage-only modifiers vs all modifiers (including lasting oe_yr_zx_a / oe_yr_zx_b).
oe_yr_strip = {
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI } c:CHI = { if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yr_settled } remove_country_modifier = oe_yr_settled } if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yr_guosu } remove_country_modifier = oe_yr_guosu } if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yr_civil } remove_country_modifier = oe_yr_civil } } }
}
oe_yr_strip_all = {
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI } c:CHI = { if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yr_settled } remove_country_modifier = oe_yr_settled } if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yr_guosu } remove_country_modifier = oe_yr_guosu } if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yr_civil } remove_country_modifier = oe_yr_civil } if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yr_zx_a } remove_country_modifier = oe_yr_zx_a } if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yr_zx_b } remove_country_modifier = oe_yr_zx_b } } }
}
# Any scope. Debug counter: events sent by this line (global oe_dbg_n_yr).
oe_yr_count = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_dbg_n_yr } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_yr value = 0 } }
    change_global_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_yr add = 1 }
}
# Any scope, monthly before the opening (design 3.2 step 3).
oe_yr_watch_open = {
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_phase ?= 3 } change_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_p3run add = 1 } }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_p3run value = 0 } }
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { global_var:oe_y7_phase ?= 1 global_var:oe_y7_phase ?= 2 global_var:oe_y7_phase ?= 3 } has_global_variable = oe_y7_shi global_var:oe_y7_shi >= 60 }
        change_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_shirun add = 1 }
    }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_shirun value = 0 } }
    if = { limit = { current_date >= 1373.1.1 } oe_yr_finish = { code = 4 } }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_yr_can_open = yes } oe_yr_do_open = yes }
}
# Any scope. The opening.
oe_yr_do_open = {
    set_global_variable = oe_yr_opened
    if = { limit = { oe_yr_way_1 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_how value = 1 } }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_yr_way_2 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_how value = 2 } }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_yr_way_3 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_how value = 3 } }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_how value = 4 } }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_open_m value = global_var:oe_yr_m }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI } c:CHI = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_lit0 value = average_country_literacy } } }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_defer value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_d1 value = 1 }
    debug_log = "oe_yr: the restoration opens (way [GetCountry('CHI').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_yr_rd_how')|0])"
}
# Any scope, monthly once open (design 3.2 steps 4-6).
oe_yr_step = {
    if = { limit = { oe_yr_dadu_lost = yes } oe_yr_abort = { why = 3 } }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_yr_y7_lost = yes } oe_yr_abort = { why = 4 } }
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_on NOT = { global_var:oe_yr_path ?= 0 } }
        oe_yr_checks = yes
        oe_yr_side_due = yes
        oe_yr_strain_step = yes
        if = {
            limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_on global_var:oe_yr_stage ?= 0 global_var:oe_yr_strain >= 12 }
            oe_yr_abort = { why = 1 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_on global_var:oe_yr_stage ?= 0 NOT = { global_var:oe_yr_ever1 ?= 1 } global_var:oe_yr_m >= oe_yr_ten_m }
            oe_yr_abort = { why = 2 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_on global_var:oe_yr_stage >= 1 global_var:oe_yr_strain >= 12 NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_d7 } oe_yr_asked_7 = no }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_d7 value = 1 }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            has_global_variable = oe_yr_on
            NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_d1 }
            oe_yr_asked_1 = no
            OR = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_defer_m } global_var:oe_yr_m >= global_var:oe_yr_defer_m }
        }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_d1 value = 1 }
    }
}
# Any scope, monthly with a road: schedule phase 2 & 3 events (.5, .6, .10, .11).
oe_yr_side_due = {
    # .5 经理田粮: from stage 1 on, until done, respecting defer/initial wait month.
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_global_variable = oe_yr_stage global_var:oe_yr_stage >= 1
            global_var:oe_yr_fields ?= 0
            NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_d5 }
            oe_yr_asked_5 = no
            OR = {
                NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_fields_m }
                AND = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_m has_global_variable = oe_yr_fields_m global_var:oe_yr_m >= global_var:oe_yr_fields_m }
            }
        }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_d5 value = 1 }
    }
    # .6 复行经义取士: Road A, from stage 1 on, if Middle Kingdom is still direct_appointment, once (defer once).
    if = {
        limit = {
            global_var:oe_yr_path ?= 1
            has_global_variable = oe_yr_stage global_var:oe_yr_stage >= 1
            NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_st_6 }
            oe_yr_mk_direct = yes
            NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_d6 }
            oe_yr_asked_6 = no
            OR = {
                NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_p6_m }
                AND = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_m has_global_variable = oe_yr_p6_m global_var:oe_yr_m >= global_var:oe_yr_p6_m }
            }
        }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_d6 value = 1 }
    }
    # .10 开科取士: Road A, from stage 2 on, every 3 years in January, celestial authority > 5, policy != direct_appointment.
    if = {
        limit = {
            global_var:oe_yr_path ?= 1
            has_global_variable = oe_yr_stage global_var:oe_yr_stage >= 2
            current_month = 1
            oe_yr_keju_ready = yes
            NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_d10 }
            oe_yr_asked_10 = no
        }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_d10 value = 1 }
    }
    # .11 朝中两党: from stage 1 on, once, when Empress Ki is alive in 1357-1366 or generals' sway >= 2.
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_global_variable = oe_yr_stage global_var:oe_yr_stage >= 1
            NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_st_11 }
            oe_yr_court_due_cond = yes
            NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_d11 }
            oe_yr_asked_11 = no
        }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_d11 value = 1 }
    }
}
# Any scope, monthly with a road (design 3.4): checklists for stages 1, 2 A/B, and 3 A/B.
oe_yr_checks = {
    if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_yr_stage ?= 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_ok value = oe_yr_ok1_calc }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_need value = 3 }
        if = { limit = { oe_yr_stage1_ok = yes } change_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_hold add = 1 } }
        else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_hold value = 0 } }
        if = {
            limit = { global_var:oe_yr_hold >= 6 oe_yr_crisis = no NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_d2 } }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_d2 value = 1 }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_yr_stage ?= 1 global_var:oe_yr_path ?= 1 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_ok value = oe_yr_ok2a_calc }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_need value = 7 }
        if = { limit = { oe_yr_stage2a_ok = yes } change_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_hold add = 1 } }
        else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_hold value = 0 } }
        if = {
            limit = { global_var:oe_yr_hold >= 6 oe_yr_crisis = no NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_d3 } }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_d3 value = 1 }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_yr_stage ?= 1 global_var:oe_yr_path ?= 2 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_ok value = oe_yr_ok2b_calc }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_need value = 7 }
        if = { limit = { oe_yr_stage2b_ok = yes } change_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_hold add = 1 } }
        else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_hold value = 0 } }
        if = {
            limit = { global_var:oe_yr_hold >= 6 oe_yr_crisis = no NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_d4 } }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_d4 value = 1 }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_yr_stage ?= 2 global_var:oe_yr_path ?= 1 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_ok value = oe_yr_ok3a_calc }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_need value = 9 }
        if = { limit = { oe_yr_stage3a_ok = yes } change_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_hold add = 1 } }
        else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_hold value = 0 } }
        if = {
            limit = { global_var:oe_yr_hold >= 12 oe_yr_crisis = no NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_d8 } }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_d8 value = 1 }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_yr_stage ?= 2 global_var:oe_yr_path ?= 2 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_ok value = oe_yr_ok3b_calc }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_need value = 7 }
        if = { limit = { oe_yr_stage3b_ok = yes } change_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_hold add = 1 } }
        else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_hold value = 0 } }
        if = {
            limit = { global_var:oe_yr_hold >= 12 oe_yr_crisis = no NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_d9 } }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_d9 value = 1 }
        }
    }
    else = {
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_ok value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_need value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_hold value = 0 }
    }
}
# Any scope, monthly with a road (design 3.6): any signal +1, else -1, 0-12.
oe_yr_strain_step = {
    if = { limit = { oe_yr_strain_sig = yes } change_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_strain add = 1 } }
    else = { change_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_strain add = -1 } }
    clamp_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_strain min = 0 max = 12 }
}
# Any scope (interface, design 4.3). Usage: oe_yr_add_strain = { amount = N }.
oe_yr_add_strain = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_yr_open = yes NOT = { global_var:oe_yr_path ?= 0 } }
        change_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_strain add = $amount$ }
        clamp_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_strain min = 0 max = 12 }
    }
}
# Any scope. Usage: oe_yr_abort = { why = N }: abandonment (oe_yr_end 2).
oe_yr_abort = {
    oe_yr_fall_back_all = yes
    oe_yr_finish = { code = 2 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_why value = $why$ }
    set_global_variable = oe_yr_note
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_wait value = 0 }
}
# Any scope, monthly after an abandonment: the notice (.7) is sent once.
oe_yr_note_step = {
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { oe_yr_busy = no global_var:oe_yr_wait >= 2 } }
        remove_global_variable = oe_yr_note
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yuan_ev_m value = global_var:oe_yr_m }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_last value = 7 }
        oe_yr_count = yes
        debug_log = "oe_yr: the notice of the abandonment (oe_yr.7) sent to CHI"
        if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI } c:CHI = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_yr.7 } }
    }
    else = { change_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_wait add = 1 } }
}
# ---- rewards and their undoing (no debug_log here: options reach undo effects through .20)
# Any scope. Stage 1 passed (design 3.4): intensity -0.25 (bit 1), legitimacy +5; schedule .5 within 3 months.
oe_yr_pass_1 = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_stage value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_hold value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_saved value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_ever1 value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_arg value = -0.25 }
    oe_yr_set_strife = yes
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_last_d } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_cut1_amt value = global_var:oe_yr_last_d } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_cut_1 } } set_global_variable = oe_yr_cut_1 change_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_cut add = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI } c:CHI = { add_legitimacy = legitimacy_weak_bonus } }
    if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_yr_fields ?= 0 NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_fields_m } has_global_variable = oe_yr_m }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_fields_m value = global_var:oe_yr_m }
        change_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_fields_m add = 2 }
    }
    oe_yr_stage_mods_apply = yes
}
# Any scope. Stage 2 passed (design 3.4): remove chi_administration_in_disarray (bit 2), intensity -0.25 (bit 4);
# Road A: cabinet action unlocks via stage >= 2, spawn Wei Su (1303-1372), post-1368 oe_yr_civil;
# Road B: princes loyalty +5 (once), oe_yr_guosu.
oe_yr_pass_2 = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_stage value = 2 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_hold value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_saved value = 0 }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:CHI c:CHI = { has_country_modifier = chi_administration_in_disarray } }
        c:CHI = { remove_country_modifier = chi_administration_in_disarray }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_cut_2 } } set_global_variable = oe_yr_cut_2 change_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_cut add = 2 } }
    }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_arg value = -0.25 }
    oe_yr_set_strife = yes
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_last_d } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_cut4_amt value = global_var:oe_yr_last_d } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_cut_4 } } set_global_variable = oe_yr_cut_4 change_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_cut add = 4 } }
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yr_path ?= 1 } oe_yr_spawn_wei_su = yes }
    else_if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_yr_path ?= 2 NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_b2_loy } }
        set_global_variable = oe_yr_b2_loy
        oe_yw_change_loyalty_all = { amount = 5 }
    }
    oe_yr_stage_mods_apply = yes
}
# Any scope. Runtime character creation for Wei Su (危素, 1303-1372; Bamboo King CFP authorized data; own name key
# oe_yr_name_wei_su; guarded against Bamboo King's bk_yuan_wei_su). Xu Youren (许有壬) is already in 05_oe_s37_characters.txt.
oe_yr_spawn_wei_su = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            current_date < 1373.1.1
            NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_weisu_made }
            NOT = { character:oe_yr_wei_su ?= { is_alive = yes } }
            NOT = { character:bk_yuan_wei_su ?= { is_alive = yes } }
            country_exists = c:CHI
        }
        set_global_variable = oe_yr_weisu_made
        c:CHI = {
            create_character = {
                first_name = oe_yr_name_wei_su
                culture = culture:gan_culture
                religion = religion:sanjiao
                estate = estate_type:burghers_estate
                female = no
                birth_date = 1303.1.1
                birth_location = location:jinxi
                adm = 64
                dip = 58
                mil = 26
                script = oe_yr_wei_su
            }
        }
    }
}
# Any scope. Stage 3 passed (design 3.4 & 3.6): intensity to 0 & remove chi_factional_strife (bit 8) and disarray,
# strip stage modifiers, grant lasting oe_yr_zx_a or oe_yr_zx_b (until Yuan falls), close line with oe_yr_end = 1.
oe_yr_pass_3 = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_stage value = 3 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_hold value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_saved value = 0 }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:CHI c:CHI = { has_country_modifier = chi_administration_in_disarray } }
        c:CHI = { remove_country_modifier = chi_administration_in_disarray }
    }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_arg value = -2 }
    oe_yr_set_strife = yes
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_last_d } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_cut8_amt value = global_var:oe_yr_last_d } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_cut_8 } } set_global_variable = oe_yr_cut_8 change_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_cut add = 8 } }
    oe_yr_strip = yes
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yr_path ?= 1 } if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI } c:CHI = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_yr_zx_a years = -1 mode = replace } } } }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yr_path ?= 2 } if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI } c:CHI = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_yr_zx_b years = -1 mode = replace } } } }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_d1 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_d1 } if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_d2 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_d2 } if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_d3 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_d3 } if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_d4 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_d4 } if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_d5 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_d5 } if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_d6 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_d6 } if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_d7 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_d7 } if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_d8 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_d8 } if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_d9 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_d9 } if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_d10 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_d10 } if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_d11 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_d11 } if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_ask1 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_ask1 } if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_ask5 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_ask5 } if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_ask6 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_ask6 } if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_ask7 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_ask7 } if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_ask10 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_ask10 } if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_ask11 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_ask11 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_on } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_on }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_end value = 1 }
}
# Any scope. Undo stage 3 (used by test reset only).
oe_yr_undo_3 = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_cut_8 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_arg value = 0 }
        if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_cut8_amt } change_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_arg subtract = global_var:oe_yr_cut8_amt } }
        oe_yr_set_strife = yes
        remove_global_variable = oe_yr_cut_8
        change_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_cut add = -8 }
        if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_cut8_amt } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_cut8_amt }
    }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI } c:CHI = { if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yr_settled } remove_country_modifier = oe_yr_settled } if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yr_guosu } remove_country_modifier = oe_yr_guosu } if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yr_civil } remove_country_modifier = oe_yr_civil } if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yr_zx_a } remove_country_modifier = oe_yr_zx_a } if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yr_zx_b } remove_country_modifier = oe_yr_zx_b } } }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_stage value = 2 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_hold value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_saved value = 0 }
}
# Any scope. Undo stage 2 (retreat from stage 2 to stage 1): restore intensity bit 4 and disarray bit 2 (before 1368), strip stage 2 modifiers.
oe_yr_undo_2 = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_cut_4 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_arg value = 0 }
        if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_cut4_amt } change_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_arg subtract = global_var:oe_yr_cut4_amt } }
        oe_yr_set_strife = yes
        remove_global_variable = oe_yr_cut_4
        change_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_cut add = -4 }
        if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_cut4_amt } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_cut4_amt }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_cut_2 }
        if = {
            limit = { current_date < 1368.1.1 country_exists = c:CHI }
            c:CHI = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = chi_administration_in_disarray months = oe_yr_strife_months mode = replace } }
        }
        remove_global_variable = oe_yr_cut_2
        change_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_cut add = -2 }
    }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI } c:CHI = { if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yr_guosu } remove_country_modifier = oe_yr_guosu } if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yr_civil } remove_country_modifier = oe_yr_civil } } }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_stage value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_hold value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_saved value = 0 }
}
# Any scope. Undo stage 1 (retreat from stage 1 to stage 0): restore intensity bit 1, strip oe_yr_settled.
oe_yr_undo_1 = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_cut_1 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_arg value = 0 }
        if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_cut1_amt } change_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_arg subtract = global_var:oe_yr_cut1_amt } }
        oe_yr_set_strife = yes
        remove_global_variable = oe_yr_cut_1
        change_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_cut add = -1 }
        if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_cut1_amt } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_cut1_amt }
    }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI } c:CHI = { if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yr_settled } remove_country_modifier = oe_yr_settled } if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yr_guosu } remove_country_modifier = oe_yr_guosu } if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yr_civil } remove_country_modifier = oe_yr_civil } } }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_stage value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_hold value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_saved value = 0 }
}
# Any scope. Retreat one stage (.7 a).
oe_yr_fall_back = {
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yr_stage ?= 2 } oe_yr_undo_2 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yr_stage ?= 1 } oe_yr_undo_1 = yes }
}
# Any scope. Every stage undone (abandonment and test reset).
oe_yr_fall_back_all = {
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yr_stage ?= 3 } oe_yr_undo_3 = yes }
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yr_stage ?= 2 } oe_yr_undo_2 = yes }
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yr_stage ?= 1 } oe_yr_undo_1 = yes }
}
# Any scope. Vanilla's intensity chi_rtr_modifier_intensity on the Yuan changed by global oe_yr_arg.
oe_yr_set_strife = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:CHI }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_int_d } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_int_d value = 0 } }
        c:CHI = {
            if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = chi_rtr_modifier_intensity } } set_variable = { name = chi_rtr_modifier_intensity value = oe_yr_int_base } }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_tmp value = var:chi_rtr_modifier_intensity }
            change_variable = { name = chi_rtr_modifier_intensity add = global_var:oe_yr_arg }
            clamp_variable = { name = chi_rtr_modifier_intensity min = 0 max = 2 }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_last_d value = var:chi_rtr_modifier_intensity }
            change_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_last_d subtract = global_var:oe_yr_tmp }
            change_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_int_d add = global_var:oe_yr_last_d }
            remove_global_variable = oe_yr_tmp
            oe_yr_strife_mod = yes
        }
    }
}
# Country scope (the Yuan). Before 1368: chi_factional_strife at the intensity until 1368.1.1; at <= 0 remove it.
oe_yr_strife_mod = {
    if = {
        limit = { current_date < 1368.1.1 has_variable = chi_rtr_modifier_intensity var:chi_rtr_modifier_intensity > 0 }
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = chi_factional_strife months = oe_yr_strife_months mode = replace size = var:chi_rtr_modifier_intensity }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_country_modifier = chi_factional_strife has_variable = chi_rtr_modifier_intensity var:chi_rtr_modifier_intensity <= 0 }
        remove_country_modifier = chi_factional_strife
    }
}
# Any scope, monthly. Write back chi_rtr_modifier_intensity if vanilla removed it when Red Turbans ended.
oe_yr_resync = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_int_d NOT = { global_var:oe_yr_int_d = 0 } country_exists = c:CHI c:CHI = { NOT = { has_variable = chi_rtr_modifier_intensity } } }
        c:CHI = { set_variable = { name = chi_rtr_modifier_intensity value = oe_yr_int_base } }
    }
}
# Any scope. Stage-level modifiers renewed each January (mode = replace, 13 months).
oe_yr_stage_mods_apply = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_on has_global_variable = oe_yr_stage global_var:oe_yr_stage >= 1 global_var:oe_yr_stage < 3 }
        if = { limit = { current_date >= 1368.1.1 } if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI } c:CHI = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_yr_settled months = 13 mode = replace } } } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yr_stage ?= 2 global_var:oe_yr_path ?= 2 } if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI } c:CHI = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_yr_guosu months = 13 mode = replace } } } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yr_stage ?= 2 global_var:oe_yr_path ?= 1 current_date >= 1368.1.1 } if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI } c:CHI = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_yr_civil months = 13 mode = replace } } } }
    }
}
# Any scope. 25% roll on .5 b ("括田入官"): add oe_yr_field_unrest to a CHI-owned seat of units 2/3/4 (12m, mode = replace).
oe_yr_fields_unrest_roll = {
    random_list = {
        75 = { }
        25 = {
            random_list = {
                1 = {
                    trigger = { location:hangzhou = { owner ?= c:CHI } }
                    location:hangzhou = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_yr_field_unrest months = 12 mode = replace } }
                }
                1 = {
                    trigger = { location:nanchang = { owner ?= c:CHI } }
                    location:nanchang = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_yr_field_unrest months = 12 mode = replace } }
                }
                1 = {
                    trigger = { location:tongxu = { owner ?= c:CHI } }
                    location:tongxu = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_yr_field_unrest months = 12 mode = replace } }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------- events: senders and the pick
oe_yr_fire_1 = {
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_d1 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_d1 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_ask1 value = global_var:oe_yr_m }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yuan_ev_m value = global_var:oe_yr_m }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_wait value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_last value = 1 }
    oe_yr_count = yes
    debug_log = "oe_yr: event oe_yr.1 sent to CHI"
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI } c:CHI = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_yr.1 } }
}
oe_yr_fire_2 = {
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_d2 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_d2 } if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yr_stage ?= 0 NOT = { global_var:oe_yr_path ?= 0 } } oe_yr_pass_1 = yes }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yuan_ev_m value = global_var:oe_yr_m }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_wait value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_last value = 2 }
    oe_yr_count = yes
    debug_log = "oe_yr: event oe_yr.2 sent to CHI"

}

# Any scope. At most one event a month. Nothing in a busy month, waiting at most 2 busy months.
oe_yr_ev_pick = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_pick value = 0 }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_wait } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_wait value = 0 } }
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { oe_yr_busy = no global_var:oe_yr_wait >= 2 } }
        if = { limit = { oe_yr_due_7 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_pick value = 7 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_yr_due_8 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_pick value = 8 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_yr_due_9 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_pick value = 9 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_yr_due_3 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_pick value = 3 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_yr_due_4 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_pick value = 4 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_yr_due_2 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_pick value = 2 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_yr_due_1 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_pick value = 1 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_yr_due_11 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_pick value = 11 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_yr_due_5 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_pick value = 5 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_yr_due_6 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_pick value = 6 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_yr_due_10 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_pick value = 10 } }
    }
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yr_pick = 0 oe_yr_busy = yes oe_yr_any_due = yes } change_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_wait add = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yr_pick = 1 } oe_yr_fire_1 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yr_pick = 2 } oe_yr_fire_2 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yr_pick = 3 } oe_yr_fire_3 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yr_pick = 4 } oe_yr_fire_4 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yr_pick = 5 } oe_yr_fire_5 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yr_pick = 6 } oe_yr_fire_6 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yr_pick = 7 } oe_yr_fire_7 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yr_pick = 8 } oe_yr_fire_8 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yr_pick = 9 } oe_yr_fire_9 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yr_pick = 10 } oe_yr_fire_10 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yr_pick = 11 } oe_yr_fire_11 = yes }
    remove_global_variable = oe_yr_pick
}
# Any scope. One debug_log line with the readouts (button yrlog).
oe_yr_log = { debug_log = "oe_yr m=[GetCountry('CHI').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_yr_rd_m')|0] end=[GetCountry('CHI').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_yr_rd_end')|0] oe_yr_test_start = {
    oe_yr_test_clear = yes
    oe_yr_setup = yes
    oe_yr_log = yes
}
oe_yr_test_month = {
    if = { limit = { OR = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_on has_global_variable = oe_yr_note } } oe_yr_monthly = yes oe_yr_log = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_yr TEST: the line is not running (press yrstart first)" }
}
oe_yr_test_open = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_on NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_opened } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_m value = oe_yr_m_now }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_shirun value = 24 }
        oe_yr_do_open = yes
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_how value = 3 }
    }
    oe_yr_log = yes
}
oe_yr_test_path = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_on }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_opened } } oe_yr_test_open = yes }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_path value = $n$ }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_hold value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_strain value = 0 }
        if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_d1 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_d1 }
        if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_ask1 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_ask1 }
    }
    oe_yr_log = yes
}
# Hold count set to one short of the current stage's threshold (stage 0/1 -> 5, stage 2 -> 11).
oe_yr_test_ok = {
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yr_stage ?= 2 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_hold value = 11 } }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_hold value = 5 } }
    oe_yr_log = yes
}
oe_yr_test_stage1 = {
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_on global_var:oe_yr_stage ?= 0 NOT = { global_var:oe_yr_path ?= 0 } } oe_yr_pass_1 = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_yr TEST: needs a running line with a road at stage 0 (yrstart, yrpath1 or yrpath2)" }
    oe_yr_log = yes
}
oe_yr_test_stage2 = {
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_on global_var:oe_yr_stage ?= 0 NOT = { global_var:oe_yr_path ?= 0 } } oe_yr_pass_1 = yes }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_on global_var:oe_yr_stage ?= 1 NOT = { global_var:oe_yr_path ?= 0 } } oe_yr_pass_2 = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_yr TEST: needs a running line with a road at stage 0 or 1 (yrstart, yrpath1 or yrpath2)" }
    oe_yr_log = yes
}
oe_yr_test_strain = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_yr_strain value = 11 } oe_yr_log = yes }
oe_yr_test_fail = {
    if = { limit = { oe_yr_open = yes } oe_yr_abort = { why = 1 } }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_yr TEST: the restoration is not open (yrstart, yropen)" }
    oe_yr_log = yes
}

    debug_log = "oe_yr probe after: mods=[GetCountry('CHI').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_yr_rd_mods')|0] (look again after the month turns)"
}

    }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_yr probe: the Yuan does not lead the Middle Kingdom" }
}

    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_ever1 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_ever1 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_note } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_note }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_wait } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_wait }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_pick } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_pick }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_last } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_last }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_y1n } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_y1n }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_dbg_n_yr } remove_global_variable = oe_dbg_n_yr }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_d1 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_d1 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_d2 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_d2 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_d3 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_d3 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_d4 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_d4 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_d5 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_d5 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_d6 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_d6 }

    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_d10 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_d10 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yr_d11 } remove_global_variable = oe_yr_d11 }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI } c:CHI = { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yr_job } remove_variable = oe_yr_job } } }
}
